findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in pandas
 * @description Detect uses of pickle and similar modules that may deserialize untrusted data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/pandas-unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().regexpMatch("^pandas/io/.*") and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pandas.io.pickle").getMember(["read_pickle", "to_pickle"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pandas").getMember("read_pickle").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation in pandas IO layer."
findings.hypothesis: Pandas IO layer may expose unsafe deserialization primitives that could be misused with untrusted data

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation in pandas IO layer.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Pandas unsafe deserialization via pickle IO
 * @description Find uses of pickle.load/loads and pandas.io.pickle that may deserialize untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/pandas-pickle-io-unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "pandas/io/pickle.py" and
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
select call, "Pandas pickle IO uses the standard library pickle API, which is unsafe on untrusted input. Ensure only trusted data is deserialized."
findings.hypothesis: pandas IO pickle module wraps Python pickle and thus exposes unsafe deserialization entrypoints

message.text: Pandas pickle IO uses the standard library pickle API, which is unsafe on untrusted input. Ensure only trusted data is deserialized.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval in pandas.eval/query
 * @description Detect use of eval/numexpr evaluation that might execute untrusted expressions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pandas-eval-injection-surfaces
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().regexpMatch("^pandas/core/computation/.*") and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pandas.core.computation.eval").getMember("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pandas").getMember(["eval", "DataFrame!"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Use of expression evaluation functionality that may execute arbitrary expressions if fed untrusted input. Review how user input reaches this API in applications."
findings.hypothesis: Expression evaluation helpers in pandas could be used in insecure ways if applications pass untrusted strings

message.text: Use of expression evaluation functionality that may execute arbitrary expressions if fed untrusted input. Review how user input reaches this API in applications.
